brand.description: Action fill, active indicators, progress fill

on-brand.description: Text and icons on brand fill

danger.description: Error. Fills and rules in both themes; text and border roles use danger-ink on light (spec 2.3)

warn.description: Warning. Fills and rules in both themes; text and border roles use warn-ink on light (spec 2.3)

bg.description: App background beneath the light field

ink2.description: Secondary text, labels, captions. Never apply opacity multipliers (spec 2.5)

ink3.description: Non-text only: chevrons, dividers, disabled. Light value deliberately raised from #8A929E to clear 3:1. Never apply opacity multipliers (spec 2.5)

ink-muted.description: Tertiary text: placeholders, ticket IDs, timestamps

accent-ink.description: Accent text only. Brand #C8FF00 must never set type on light (spec 2.4)

glass-fill.description: Panel fill. Light is deliberately more opaque than dark; do not correct (spec 6)

icon-bg.description: Icon wells. NOT progress tracks — see track-solid (spec 6.3)

track-solid.description: Opaque track behind disputable numbers: KPI ring, KRA bars, leave balance bars (spec 6.3 — a number a person may dispute with their manager must not be read through a moving tint). Values are the exact composite of icon-bg over glass, so the appearance is unchanged; being solid, it no longer shifts with what sits behind it

surface.description: Card/control surface — the glass tone (a subtle lift from the page), NOT the #313133/#ECEDEF bar-track. Decoupled so cards stop inheriting the heavy track: on the track, muted text fell to 3.41:1 (dark) / 4.14:1 (light), both below WCAG AA; on this tone it is 4.71 / 4.73. bg-surface maps here; bars keep track-solid.

scrim.description: Modal and action-sheet backdrop (spec 10.3 #25, #26). Not in the spec's token table: CustomIonModal's focus-trap workaround hand-builds its backdrop, so a scrim value is required and the mockup never showed one

glass-fill-fallback.description: Solid panel fill where backdrop-filter is unsupported (spec 6.1) and in reduce-transparency mode (spec 6.2). Layout must not change

danger-ink.description: Error text and border. Light measured 4.54

warn-ink.description: Warning text and border. Light measured 4.73

warn-fill.description: The offline bar FILL, carrying --g-bg as its text. Not --g-warn-ink: that is a TEXT colour for glass, and at #B45309 the 10.5px caption over it measures 4.36 against the 4.5 floor. DISTINCT from warn-ink in BOTH themes on purpose — identical values are two names for one colour, and the tokens gate is right that a swap between them would then be invisible. Light 6.33, dark 6.32.

leave-ink.description: Leave text and border. Light measured 4.55 on the violet-26% tint

success-ink.description: Success text and border. Light measured 4.60 on the teal-20% tint

action.description: Primary action shadow (spec 10.1 #1). Glow rides --g-brand-rgb so a brand change propagates

focus-ring.description: Keyboard focus-visible ring (WCAG 2.4.7): 2px ink halo + 3px brand ring. Rides --g-ink so it inverts to white in dark. Single source — every :focus-visible references this, not a copied literal

focus-ring-inset.description: Inset variant of focus-ring for controls inside an overflow:hidden panel (list rows), where the outer ring would be clipped at the panel edge. Same ink+brand language, drawn inward so it stays fully visible

screen-gutter.description: Left/right padding of all screen content Moved to the 4pt grid, 22 Sep 2026 (was 15px): every screen density divides by 4, so an off-grid value lands on a fractional device pixel and rounds differently per handset.

stack-sm.description: Between sibling cards in a grid Moved to the 4pt grid, 22 Sep 2026 (was 9px): every screen density divides by 4, so an off-grid value lands on a fractional device pixel and rounds differently per handset.

stack-md.description: Between major blocks Moved to the 4pt grid, 22 Sep 2026 (was 13px): every screen density divides by 4, so an off-grid value lands on a fractional device pixel and rounds differently per handset.

pad-panel.description: Balance cards, stat tiles Moved to the 4pt grid, 22 Sep 2026 (was 14px 13px): every screen density divides by 4, so an off-grid value lands on a fractional device pixel and rounds differently per handset.

pad-row.description: List rows Moved to the 4pt grid, 22 Sep 2026 (was 11.5px 15px): every screen density divides by 4, so an off-grid value lands on a fractional device pixel and rounds differently per handset.

pad-action.description: Primary and ghost buttons Moved to the 4pt grid, 22 Sep 2026 (was 17px 18px): every screen density divides by 4, so an off-grid value lands on a fractional device pixel and rounds differently per handset.

pad-badge.description: Badges Moved to the 4pt grid, 22 Sep 2026 (was 3.5px 8px): every screen density divides by 4, so an off-grid value lands on a fractional device pixel and rounds differently per handset.

sheet-pad-bottom.description: Bottom padding inside a sheet, ADDED to the safe-area inset. Single-value on purpose: pad-panel is two-value ('14px 13px'), so max(var(--g-pad-panel), env(...)) was invalid CSS, the declaration was dropped, and every sheet's primary button sat flush against the viewport floor Moved to the 4pt grid, 22 Sep 2026 (was 14px): every screen density divides by 4, so an off-grid value lands on a fractional device pixel and rounds differently per handset.

fab-bottom.description: Bottom offset of a floating action button on a tab destination. DERIVED from the bar's own tokens rather than measured: SopList carried bottom-[76px], which was correct against a 64+9 bar and silently wrong the moment any of the four values moved. Ionic forces content-box on the tab bar host, so the paddings sit OUTSIDE tabbar-height and all four terms are needed.

radius-action.description: Buttons, map panel, selfie panel Moved to the 4pt grid, 22 Sep 2026 (was 19px): every screen density divides by 4, so an off-grid value lands on a fractional device pixel and rounds differently per handset.

display.description: Display stack. Do not bundle SF Pro

clock.description: Check-in time Step on the 12-14-16-19-23-28-34-40 ramp (ratio ~1.2), set 22 Sep 2026; was 36px. Half-pixel sizes render at a different weight on every device pixel ratio, and steps closer than 1.125 are two names for one size.

eyebrow.description: Eyebrow, e.g. H1 2026 REVIEW. No opacity multipliers (spec 2.5) Step on the 12-14-16-19-23-28-34-40 ramp (ratio ~1.2), set 22 Sep 2026; was 10.5px. Half-pixel sizes render at a different weight on every device pixel ratio, and steps closer than 1.125 are two names for one size.

badge.description: Badge, e.g. OPEN Step on the 12-14-16-19-23-28-34-40 ramp (ratio ~1.2), set 22 Sep 2026; was 10px. Half-pixel sizes render at a different weight on every device pixel ratio, and steps closer than 1.125 are two names for one size.

tab-label.description: Tab bar label, e.g. HOME. 10px at 0.02em tracking, NOT a step on the 12-14-16-19-23-28-34-40 ramp and deliberately outside it. Five uppercase labels must fit one bar at the 320px floor, which gives each 57.6px: CALENDAR measures 50.7px here and 65.7px at the ramp's 12px step with its 0.07em tracking. That step shipped on 22 Sep 2026 and rendered CALENDARREQUESTS on every screen in the app, because each label's overflow:hidden clipped its own box while the boxes overlapped. The ramp governs type a person READS; a tab label is a fitting problem and the bar is the constraint that wins. Arithmetic in frontend/src/components/__tests__/tabbar-fits.test.js.

data-system.description: Data / system: coordinates, ticket IDs Step on the 12-14-16-19-23-28-34-40 ramp (ratio ~1.2), set 22 Sep 2026; was 10px. Half-pixel sizes render at a different weight on every device pixel ratio, and steps closer than 1.125 are two names for one size.

row-tap.description: Row tap: background transitions to icon-bg

skeleton-shimmer.description: Skeleton shimmer. Becomes a static fill under prefers-reduced-motion

state-change.description: A control changing state in place — a toggle, a chip, a selected row. Material 3's SHORT band (50-200ms): long enough to be seen as a change rather than a jump, short enough that a rapid tapper never waits. Replaces --motion-glide, which SopFormSheet referenced four times and which has been defined nowhere since the Modernist stylesheet was removed: four dead transitions that simply snapped.

overlay.description: Dialogs and action sheets. NOTE: sticky is numerically above this, so a sticky header currently paints over an open dialog. Preserved as-is in phase 3 — the values are promoted, not re-ordered; re-ordering is a behaviour change and needs its own review

scrim.description: The hand-built modal backdrop (GModal), which must sit above everything including a sticky header

scrim-backdrop.description: The dimmer behind a hand-built modal. Same level as `scrim` by design: the backdrop and the sheet it dims are one surface in two elements, and z-[10000] was written by hand in CustomIonModal where nothing tied it to the token.

content-column.description: Content column width. Was authored as '100% - 30px', which is not a valid CSS value on its own; wrapped in calc() so the layout group can be emitted Moved to the 4pt grid, 22 Sep 2026 (was calc(100% - 30px)): every screen density divides by 4, so an off-grid value lands on a fractional device pixel and rounds differently per handset.

content-column-lg.description: Desktop content column at lg: (spec 20.3). SIGNED OFF at 720px on 22 September 2026. The spec offered it for tuning once somebody had seen it on a real screen; the owner accepted it unchanged. Written here rather than only in a plan, because a token that reads as unfinished invites the question to be re-opened by whoever meets it next.

sheet-max-height.description: Bottom-sheet ceiling (spec 10.3 #25). GModal owns this shape; the token exists so the CSS layer and the Tailwind max-h-sheet utility read the same value. dvh, not vh: 100vh is the viewport with the address bar RETRACTED, and the bar is showing most of the time, so a sheet sized against it runs its confirm button off the bottom of the screen. The vh fallback stays because a browser that cannot read dvh drops that declaration entirely.

tabbar-gap.description: Gap beneath the tab bar, above the safe area. The tab bar never scrolls Moved to the 4pt grid, 22 Sep 2026 (was 9px): every screen density divides by 4, so an off-grid value lands on a fractional device pixel and rounds differently per handset.

touch-target-min.description: Minimum touch target. Tappable area padded out to 44px without moving the visual

tabbar-height.description: Height of the floating tab bar. Set EXPLICITLY on the bar and reused as the bottom scroll padding of any page inside ion-tabs (8.3). Raised 58->64 in 8.6 so each tab button clears the 44px minimum (§14.1): the bar's 11px/9px vertical padding leaves 44px of button inside 64px of bar. The scroll reservation reads the same token, so the two cannot drift

tabbar-pad-top.description: Top inner padding of the floating tab bar. Ionic forces box-sizing: content-box !important on the ion-tab-bar host (light DOM cannot override it), so this padding sits OUTSIDE tabbar-height in the rendered box. Named so the scroll reservation (8.3) can read it instead of copying it — see tabbar-border. Moved to the 4pt grid, 22 Sep 2026 (was 11px): every screen density divides by 4, so an off-grid value lands on a fractional device pixel and rounds differently per handset.

tabbar-pad-bottom.description: Bottom inner padding of the floating tab bar. Same content-box reasoning as tabbar-pad-top: it adds to the bar's rendered height and must be readable by the scroll reservation, not just by the bar's own rule. Moved to the 4pt grid, 22 Sep 2026 (was 9px): every screen density divides by 4, so an off-grid value lands on a fractional device pixel and rounds differently per handset.

tabbar-border.description: Border width of the floating tab bar, one edge. Content-box adds it twice to the rendered height (top edge + bottom edge); the scroll reservation must count both.

content-column-read.description: Long-form reading column (SOP detail). Held SEPARATELY from content-column-lg although both are 720px today: a reading measure is set by characters per line (Bringhurst: 45-75; 720px of 16px type is ~72) and an app column by layout, so a future change to one must not silently move the other. SopDetail drew 820px, which runs a line past 80 characters.

viewport-floor.description: The narrowest supported viewport (revamp §27). WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.10 (Reflow) requires content to work at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling, and it is also where a 390px phone lands at 200% text zoom (SC 1.4.4). No layout in this app had ever been checked there until 22 Sep 2026; frontend/tests/responsive-floor.test.mjs now refuses a fixed width, a min-width or a fixed grid track that cannot fit inside it.

icon-sm.description: The spec's own icon grid (§9): stroke line icons are drawn 16x16. Inline glyphs inside a row of text.

icon-md.description: Default UI icon: list-row leading icons, chevrons, tab bar. Replaces the hand-picked 17, 18 and 19px that meant this.

icon-lg.description: An icon that is the subject of its row rather than a marker beside it — empty-state glyphs, section headers. Replaces 22px.

icon-xl.description: Avatar and large empty-state art. Replaces 30px and 34px.

control-md.description: A square tappable control at the platform floor (HIG 44pt / Material 48dp). Anything smaller needs padding out, not shrinking.

control-lg.description: Floating action button. Material 3's FAB is 56dp; the app drew 52, three px under a size every Android user recognises by touch.
